description: Replace the SN74LV1T125 RGB buffer with the Espressif DevKitC-1 diode plus 5 V pull-up level shift.
requested_by: User: match the official schematic, which drives the WS2812B with a 1N4148W and a 5 V pull-up.

moved_components: R15 330R front side, 111.00/122.75 mm -> 116.12/122.15 mm, next to the D2 DIN pad
unchanged_components: all other footprints keep position, angle and side

topology.chain: U1.34 (GPIO21) -> D6 cathode; D6 anode = LED_DATA_5V; R19 10k from LED_DATA_5V to VBUS_USB; R15 330R to LED_DIN; D2.3 DIN
topology.led_supply: VBUS_USB (raw USB 5 V, ahead of the D5 backfeed diode) as before

signal_levels.method: Hand calculation from the 1N4148WS datasheet limits and the WS2812B 0.7/0.3 x VDD thresholds; not measured on hardware.
signal_levels.high_level_v: GPIO 3.3 V + VF(about 0.55-0.65 V at roughly 0.11 mA) = about 3.85-3.95 V versus VIH 3.5 V at VDD 5.0 V
signal_levels.low_level_v: VOL(about 0.1 V) + VF(about 0.6 V) = about 0.7 V versus VIL 1.5 V at VDD 5.0 V
signal_levels.rise_time_estimate_ns: about 105 ns to cross VIH with 10 kohm and roughly 10 pF
signal_levels.gpio_clamp_note: With GPIO21 high impedance the pull-up drives the node through the ESP32 ESD clamp at about 50 uA, the same as the official board.
not_verified: No oscilloscope capture of the WS2812B timing

baseline_after_refill.note: Committed board with zones refilled, before the RGB change
